coreOperatorRecipes.live-child-button: Physically tap the live child button; record its counter increment and unchanged map-click counter from fresh renderer reads.
coreOperatorRecipes.nested-scroll: Swipe inside the live child list; observe changed visible list content and unchanged map camera. Use genuine input and visual evidence.
coreOperatorRecipes.live-activation: Tap the non-child live marker body and observe marker-click. Native dragging is removed and is not a success criterion.
coreOperatorRecipes.annotation-activation: Tap the visible annotation and observe annotation-click; do not infer interactive child support from its bitmap.
coreOperatorRecipes.offset-touch-bounds: Toggle offset, activate the visibly displaced child, then reset and activate again. Record actual bounds, touches and scale; no native drag.
coreOperatorRecipes.popup-follow-dismissal: Pan/zoom and observe the bubble attachment; activate its child, dismiss once, reopen and verify teardown/remount adds no stale dismissal.
coreOperatorRecipes.map-feature-click: Physically tap projected point707 with interactiveLayerIds filtering, and repeat after remount. Record actual source-click/map callback data; no retired source bubbling or hitbox API.
coreOperatorRecipes.navigation-location: Use Zoom in/out and Reset north with renderer reads; tap Locate me using the fixture supplied constant coordinate [-122.33,47.62], observe camera and UserLocation. No sensor request.
coreOperatorRecipes.style-remount: Apply style, then remount; require generation>=1, load>=2, known feature and working child/source interactions afterward, with no error/stale callback.
coreOperatorRecipes.host-accessibility: Inspect host and child accessibility labels/roles using the native hierarchy and visible controls. Full VoiceOver/TalkBack audit is excluded.
coreOperatorRecipes.sdk-ornaments: Inspect SDK scale, logo/legal attribution and available attribution interaction; inspect application control placement and empty overlay touches. No deleted common units/width policy.
coreOperatorRecipes.camera-target-and-gesture: Request Target A, physically pan to B, Repeat target with equal values and verify B remains. Request changed Target B and verify camera movement; Clear target and confirm gestures remain usable.
coreOperatorRecipes.marker-prop-rejection: Use all four rejection actions for live/annotation draggable and callback props; observe the intended rejection message, no drag callback, and clear rejection between cases.

retainedOperatorRecipes.simultaneous-named-maps: Read both actual map instances, touch each known feature and record independent named-map readbacks and finite measured viewports.
retainedOperatorRecipes.provider-child-state: Increment both children before and after Theme update; require updated context in both children and retained local counts across resize.
retainedOperatorRecipes.annotation-image-refresh: Use Image, observe delayed image load and explicit annotation refresh, inspect resulting bitmap; require image-load/image-refresh and no image-error.
retainedOperatorRecipes.resize-orientation: Use Resize both ways, then landscape and portrait on the owned device; find current controls from fresh hierarchy and record valid changed bounds and orientation readbacks.
retainedOperatorRecipes.camera-target-isolation: Move only Map A and record its changed center while Map B stays fixed; repeat equal target without rollback, then clear. Verify named children read their own map.
retainedOperatorRecipes.touch-density-bounds: Physically activate children/features at their actual current bounds in both layouts; record actual window.scale and logical viewport measurements, with no synthetic callback invocation.

androidBatch.estimatedMinutes: 60-120, unmeasured; four operator-driven UI rows dominate
androidBatch.ownership: One private OneMapU25F05 emulator-5580 per batch,5580/5581, Metro8081, status8797 only during UI rows; install each verified APK once. Outer owns reverse8081; UI driver borrows it and owns only reverse8797. Group-owned child Metro is terminated with its driver; unknown listeners/devices/sourceAVD/sharedadb/SDK remain untouched. No builds, dependencies, fixture8798 or status8799.
androidBatch.reportProtocol: Each UI row initializes OUTPUT/<rowId>-manual.json exclusively with binary/dist/environment/runId and unverified scenario slots. Worker acts as physical operator with adb input, fresh UI hierarchy and screenshots/readbacks; observes actual behavior and atomically replaces only this report after each observation. Preserve all identity fields. Add observations keyed by scenario with action, seen result, renderer data or temporary screenshot path; status alone or callback logs alone are insufficient. First failed slot aborts; leave unexercised slots unverified. A passing row requires a final physical Read renderer/Finish focus after all outcomes pass. No synthetic callback events or autofilled passes. Output/<rowId>-result.json and final receipt preserve passed prefix.
androidBatch.cleanup: On first failure or completion, stop owned app, driver/Metro groups, acquired reverses, emulator; verify owned process exit and5580/5581/8081/8797 release before removing privateAVD. Preserve uncertain launch. Expected row shutdowns are not new failures; unexpected exits are never cleared. XML temporary files belong only to this attempt.
androidBatch.failurePolicy: Stop first failed observation/command/identity/cleanup. No independent repairs or retries. Preserve completed row results; a repair or continuation gets approval for remaining work only.
